title: Monroe: A Molecular Foundation Model for In-Context Probabilistic Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.18982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bioassay activity prediction is often data-limited because drug-discovery datasets rely on time-consuming and expensive wet-lab experiments for data generation and evaluation. This challenge has inspired recent research into molecular foundation models (MFMs), which aim to encode general-purpose chemical knowledge into molecular representations that generalize well in data-constrained scenarios. This paper presents Monroe, a new MFM with several innovations over the existing state of the art: increased scale allowing pre-training on over 81 million molecules from the PM6 quantum chemistry dataset; improved graph representation of stereochemistry; improved training losses including conformer denoising and embedding decorrelation; improved multi-task learning; and the use of a prior-data-fitted model (TabPFN) for downstream in-context prediction. translated_title: 门罗：用于上下文概率推断的分子基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18982v1 公告类型：新 摘要：生物活性测定预测常常受限于数据量，因为药物发现数据集依赖于耗时且昂贵的湿实验室实验来进行数据生成和评估。这一挑战激发了近期对分子基础模型（MFMs）的研究，这些模型旨在将通用化学知识编码到分子表示中，使其在数据受限场景下具有良好的泛化能力。本文介绍了门罗（Monroe），一种新型MFM，相对于现有技术具有多项创新：扩大规模，可在PM6量子化学数据集的超过8100万个分子上进行预训练；改进立体化学的图表示；改进训练损失，包括构象去噪和嵌入去相关；改进多任务学习；以及使用先验数据拟合模型（TabPFN）进行下游上下文预测。我们的评估采用一种原则性的配对比较框架，该框架测量统计显著性。
tldr: 门罗是一种新型分子基础模型，通过扩大预训练规模、改进立体化学表示、优化损失函数和多任务学习，并结合TabPFN实现上下文概率推断，显著提升了数据受限下的生物活性预测性能。
en_tdlr: Monroe is a novel molecular foundation model that enhances data-limited bioactivity prediction through larger-scale pretraining, improved stereochemistry representation, optimized losses, multi-task learning, and TabPFN-based in-context inference.
